name: Balance EQ Situations and Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Starting points for Balance EQ for mixing down and mastering in many music styles and situations: club, festival, big room, home hi-fi, headphones, studio reference, radio and car, plus 32 music styles for streaming. Every preset sets its own band frequencies, Q values and gains (a low shelf, three bells and a high shelf; gains stay within about 3.5 dB). A situation adds its own correction to the style, for example more low end for a club or a gentler top for headphones.
